description.text: The promos of Japan's Scarlet & Violet years, with an SV-P suffix and PROMO in place of an expansion code, released from 18 November 2022, when 001/SV-P Pikachu came as an early purchase bonus for Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, to January 2026. Many came in Pokémon Card Gym Promo Card Packs and Extra Battle Day packs, at Champions League and the Japan Championships, and in Endorsed Independent Event Trainers Packs; others came from collaborations such as the NAKANO STYLING TANTO and Yu Nagaba packs, the Victini BWR Competition, and sets, decks and campaigns. Matching SV-P promos also came out in Traditional Chinese, Thai, Indonesian and Korean.

description.text: Victory Symbol is the trophy card of Japan's Champions League in the Scarlet & Violet era. It was never sold or given to entrants: only the top finishers of each league received one, in a print for their place. This 3rd Place print went to the players who finished third and fourth in each league at the 2023 tournaments, in Aichi, Miyagi and Niigata; small text on the Champions League logo names the placing and the city of each copy.
